title: drain.dryrun.json — drain post preview
description: The preview drain --post --dry-run writes beside the plan: the exact marked replies a real post would send and every thread it would skip. It is not a receipt: no reply ids, no host result, and no ledger change.

schema_version.description: Preview format version; only "1" is published.

provider.description: The host whose live thread feed the preview read.

head_sha.description: The bundle head the live feed was read at.

planned_at.description: UTC time the preview was written, RFC 3339.

planned.description: Replies a real --post would send, in draft order, with their final bodies.

skipped.description: Threads a real --post would skip, each with a machine-readable reason.

pr.description: Pull-request number the preview belongs to.

planned.description: One reply that would be posted: its thread, root comment, disposition, and final body with the marker.

skip.description: One thread left open and why: resolved, answered, stale-thread, already-replied, defer, no-draft, or a missing refreshed thread.
